title: FAMOUS Bath City Centre Walk || ENGLAND
description:
4K Bath City Centre Walk - Brigerton Location

Bath is the largest city in the county of Somerset, England, known for and named after its Roman-built baths. Bath is in the valley of the River Avon, 97 miles (156 km) west of London and 11 miles (18 km) southeast of Bristol.

 Bath is a city with a remarkable variety of Roman, medieval and Georgian architecture. It also has much in common with the nearby Cotswolds; its architectural gems are of the same golden coloured stone.

THINGS TO DO in Bath City Centre
• Thermae Bath Spa
• Roman Baths
• Theatre Royal Bath
• SouthGate Bath
• The Little Theatre Cinema

OTHER Bath City Centre attractions:
• Sally Lunn's
• Victoria Art Gallery
• Chapel Arts Centre
• Cotswold Way
• Bath Mission Theater

THINGS TO SEE in Bath City Centre
• Bath Abbey
• Guildhall
• Bath Central Library
• Parade Gardens

You may even find inspiration for your next walk or holiday.

title: A Detailed 4K Walk From Top to Bottom 🇮🇹 The Best of Positano 2026 (4K)
description:
#Positano #Italy4K #AmalfiCoast #WalkingTour #TravelItaly #PositanoItaly


The ultimate immersive walking tour of Positano, Italy! In this detailed 4K walk, we start at the very top of this vertical city and wind our way down through its iconic narrow alleys, vibrant bougainvillea-covered streets, and legendary staircases, all the way to the crystal-clear waters of Spiaggia Grande.

Whether you're planning your own Amalfi Coast adventure or just looking for a relaxing escape, this "Best of Positano" walk captures the essence of Italy's most picturesque town. Feel like you're stepping into a postcard as we explore the hidden gems and famous landmarks that make this place a UNESCO World Heritage site.

🎥 In this video, you’ll see:
👀 The breathtaking panoramic views from the top of the town.
👀 Charming local boutiques and artisan shops.
👀 The stunning Church of Santa Maria Assunta.
👀 The lively atmosphere of the main beach (Spiaggia Grande).
👀 ASMR city sounds for a truly immersive experience.

🎥 Filmed on: 5:15 PM Friday, June 5, 2025
 Temperature: 76°F | 24°C 🌤️

title: Malaga Spain | 4K Walking Tour Through Historic Streets and City Life
description:
Malaga blends rich Andalusian heritage with a dynamic urban rhythm. This 4K walking tour explores Malaga city streets at eye level, revealing how tradition and modern life meet in one of southern Spain most visited destinations.

As part of the Costa del Sol, Malaga Spain stands out for its cultural depth and welcoming atmosphere. The walk presents a close look at how everyday life unfolds in this Mediterranean hub, far from the rush of typical tourist routes.

With every step, Malaga reveals its character a city where history, architecture, and daily movement connect naturally. This walking tour offers a real-time experience of its streets, plazas, and local moments without voiceovers or interruptions.

Hey friends! 💕
Join me for a stroll through Millennium Park in Chicago. We'll walk along N Michigan Ave, passing by E Lake St and E Wacker Dr. As we continue, we'll check out the DuSable Bridge, the iconic Wrigley Building, and the lovely Plaza of the Americas. And don't forget to notice the Burberry Store building, it's a real beauty! Our walk wraps up at Jane M. Byrne Plaza Park.
If you enjoy this adventure, give my small channel a thumbs up to show some love! 💕

🎥 Filmed on: 2:30 PM Sunday, December 24, 2023
Temperature: 57°F | 13°C 🌤️

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ellie.walkss

title: 4K NYC Walking - Brooklyn Botanic Garden - The Japanese Garden And More
description:
Hey guys! Brooklyn Botanic Garden is a botanical garden in the borough of Brooklyn in New York City. There are quite a few different types of gardens located there. We will visit most of the gardens. My favorite parts of the walk were Bonsai Museum, Desert Pavilion, and The Japanese Garden. But you decide which one is your favorite. Please share with me what you like most. Love from Ellie ❤️

Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ellie.walkss

If you like this video, please give it a thumbs up and subscribe to my channel for more videos.

title: Seaside Walk in Burry Port, WALES - Home to Amelia Earhart's Historic Landing
description:
Burry Port is a Town in the county of Carmarthenshire, Wales. Burry Port is home to a harbour and is where Amelia Earhart landed as the first woman to fly across the Atlantic Ocean.

This video was recorded on 20th April 2022

Two Welsh villages, two miled apart, claims to be the spot where Amelia Earhart landed to become the first woman to complete a transatlantic flight. Both villages have monuments of the day - June of 1928.

1. Pwll has the official blue plaque used in Britain to mark important places, people, and events.
2. The other claimant, Burry Port, has erect more plaques, and make them bigger.

Burry Port was initially known as Pembrey New Harbour, it was built to accommodate larger ships than could the nearby Pembrey harbour.

Burry Port Harbour was built in the 1830's to ship coal from the Gwendraeth Valley. Tinplate, copper, silver and lead works grew up alongside.

Burry Port Lighthouse is a harbour light with a reflector, and is situated on the west breakwater of the outer harbour. It was built in 1842.

Pembrey and Burry Port is a fast developing community situated on the coastal belt of the Carmarthenshire Burry Estuary.


About My Channel:
I explore the English Countryside, brining you relaxing and calming walks around English villages and towns. I will bring you weekly videos of casual and relaxing walks around the English Countryside, sometimes beyond that. My videos help you to relax and find peace in the ambience of nature, no added music, no talking, just walking and exploring the beauty of the English Countryside through my lens. You may even find inspiration for your next walk or holiday.

I explore the English Countryside, brining you relaxing and calming walks around English villages and towns. description:
#nycwalkingtour #4kwalk #manhattan #nycwalk #newyork #lowermanhattan #broadway #soho

Hey Friends!
Let's take a long walk in Lower Manhattan! We are going to walk on Broadway from Financial District to SoHo. We will also see "Geo" and "The Bean" sculptures. I hope you enjoy the walk and have a wonderful day or night, depending on where you are!
Ellie ❤️

Hello friends! 💕 🥶 Take a stroll in Central Park, New York City, during a heavy snowfall. The fluffy flakes blanket the trees and paths, creating a magical winter wonderland. As you walk along the 4k route, you'll be mesmerized by the serene beauty of the snow-covered landscape. Every step offers a new breathtaking view, with snowflakes softly falling around you. It's a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of the city, where you can immerse yourself in the tranquility of nature's winter charm.

🎥 Filmed on: 10:00 AM Tuesday, February 13, 2024
Temperature: 32°F | 0°C ❄️ 🌨️

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

Follow me on Instagram:
 https://www.instagram.com/ellie.walkss/

title: Three Cities Malta Walking Tour 4K | Explore Vittoriosa, Senglea & Cospicua 🇲🇹
description:
Tucked across the Grand Harbour from Valletta, the Three Cities of Malta, Vittoriosa, Senglea, and Cospicua, hold the essence of Malta’s layered past. This 4K walking tour moves at the rhythm of stone underfoot and salt in the air, tracing narrow lanes, bastions, and quiet waterfronts that tourists often overlook.

Begin in Cospicua Malta, where fortified walls and sleepy alleyways form a prelude to the deeper heart of this region. The walking tour flows naturally toward Vittoriosa Malta, also known as Birgu, a place where stories of knights, sieges, and quiet revolutions cling to every archway and square. In Senglea Malta, the harbor breeze carries the scent of the sea and the distant hum of passing boats—every corner offering a scenic walk laced with history and reflection.

This Three Cities Malta walking tour is more than a stroll it's a virtual tour through time. With only ambient sound as your companion, it's a relaxing walk designed to let the places speak for themselves. No commentary, no distractions. Just the raw rhythm of the Three Cities one of the Malta top 10 places to visit.

Whether you're planning a trip or simply want to explore from home, this 4K scenic walk delivers a close-up view of a side of Malta few truly see. Walk, listen, and explore the 3 Cities of Malta.

🔔 Please Subscribe! If you enjoyed this walking tour video, don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more travel content! Share your experiences in Malta Three Cities or ask any questions in the comments below.

title: ✨🗽 4K NYC Christmas Walk - Times Square December 2022!
description:
Hello friends!
Want to see what Times Square looks like at night in December 2022? We'll be walking around Times Square in 4K, so you can see the city as it really looks!

Let's walk in Times Square during the night and enjoy all the lights and colorful screens. On our way, we will see Harry Potter Play, Aladdin the Musical, The Lion King, Madame Tussauds New York, AMC Empire 25, Hard Rock Cafe, Times Square's 2022 Ball, and M&M'S World New York among many other landmarks.

Times Square is a bustling destination in the heart of the Theater District known for bright lights, shopping & shows. As we walk around Times Square, you'll be able to see all of the fun and excitement that Times Square is known for. Be sure to catch all the amazing sights as we walk through this iconic NYC location! I hope you enjoy our walk!

title: Amsterdam 4K Walking Tour Netherlands 🇳🇱
description:
Walk on the streets of Amsterdam! On this walking tour we explore the beautiful Amsterdam, capital of the Netherlands. Walking we will travel from canal systems to really narrow houses with gabled facades, legacies of Amsterdam's Golden Age of the 17th century in 4K full HD resolution.

Discover the charm of Amsterdam as you stroll past picturesque bridges, explore quaint neighborhoods, and indulge in the local culture. From the iconic canals to the vibrant streets, our Amsterdam walking tour unveils the city's hidden treasures and popular landmarks. Wander through charming neighborhoods, marvel at historic architecture, and immerse yourself in Amsterdam's unique atmosphere.

🔔 Don't forget to subscribe to our channel and hit the notification bell to stay updated on our latest walking tour videos!

title: 4K NYC Walk - DUMBO, Brooklyn. Time Out Market | Brooklyn Flea Market | Brooklyn Bridge Park 2023
description:
Hi Friends!
Let's enjoy our walk on this beautiful sunny spring day with delightful weather! We start the walk from Brooklyn Bridge Park and will have a short stop at Brooklyn Ice Cream factory, one of the best NYC ice cream shops, in my opinion. Then walk towards Time Out New York Market! After that, we will visit the Dumbo - Manhattan Bridge - A well-known selfie spot. We end our walk after visiting Brooklyn/Dumbo Flea market. This walk was defiantly one of my favorites so far. I hope you enjoy it too. Love // Ellie

Filmed on: 2:30 PM Saturday, April 1, 2023
Temperature: 68°F| 20°C

title: 4K New York City Walk 🇺🇸 🍕 West Manhattan | Little Island | Chelsea Market
description:
Hello hello my friends!
Let’s explore the west of Manhattan together in this beautiful warm sunny spring of 2023! We start from Greenwich Avenue and walk towards Little Island on Pier 15, a human-made floating island/park. Then we will visit the most famous NYC market, Chelsea Market. I hope you enjoy our walk. Sending you love from New York City 💕💗

🎥 Filmed on: 2:30 PM Thursday, April 13, 2023
Temperature: 77°F| 29°C

title: Amsterdam Relax Walking Tour 4K Explore Netherlands 🇳🇱
description:
Join us on this Amsterdam walking tour and explore the beauty of the city's iconic Amsterdam canals, stunning Dutch architecture and vibrant flower markets during springtime. We'll take you through the historic Amsterdam streets where you can immerse yourself in the city's unique atmosphere and rich culture.

Starting our tour at the picturesque canals of Amsterdam we'll discover the stunning architecture that lines them, including the iconic houses with their distinctive gables and facades.

In this Amsterdam City Tour we will take a stroll through the famous flower market of Amsterdam* where you can admire the colorful displays of tulips, daffodils, and other springtime blooms. This bustling market is one of the Amsterdam most popular attractions and provides a glimpse into the Dutch love for flowers.

Throughout the tour, we'll also take in the lively vibe of Amsterdam's streets and squares, where you can experience the city's unique energy. From the bustling Dam Square to the charming Jordaan district, there's something for everyone in Amsterdam.

So come with us on this walking tour Amsterdam and discover the city's hidden gems, iconic landmarks, and vibrant culture.

title: 4K Miami Beach - January 2023 - Lincoln Road to Washington Avenue
description:
Hey Friends!
In today's video, we will walk the famous Lincoln Road in Miami Beach, Florida. Pedestrian-only Lincoln Road is Miami Beach's main shopping and dining destination. I had a short trip to Miami and got to film my walk to share with you! I hope you enjoy our walk! ❤️

Filmed on: January 1, 2023
Temperature: 77°F 25°C

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ellie.walkss

title: 4K New York City 🗽🚕 🏙 🍎 Warm Day Weekend Walk on Lower Manhattan 2023 | SoHo | Broadway | Spring St
description:
#nycwalkingtour #4kwalk #manhattan #nycwalk #newyork #lowermanhattan #broadway #soho

Hey Friends! Let's enjoy a walk in the Lower Manhattan area on this warm day of Spring 2023! We start from Canal Street and continue our way towards the most popular SoHo parts, including Spring Street & Prince Street. On the way, we will see charming cafes, trendy boutiques, and some of the best restaurants in town, including Jack's Wife Freda SoHo & The Dutch & Balthazar. I hope you enjoy our walk and wish you a wonderful day or night, depending on where you are! Ellie ❤️

title: 4K ✨ ☔ Rainy Day At Festive New York City! Rockefeller Center - 5Th Ave - RadioCity
description:
Hello friends! 🫶
Let's take a walk together on December 23th on this festive rainy day that ends with snow! The holiday feeling is just here as we walk. We can feel it! We will walk around Rockefeller Center, the famous Rockefeller Center Christmas tree, and Radio City and see giant Manhattan Christmas lights and 2022 Christmas decorations on the way! We will also have a short visit to FAO Schwarz, an iconic Toy Store in NYC. I think it is an amazing place for kids and adults! But you see for yourself! I love the holiday feeling inside the store, hope you will too!
XOXO Ellie

As promised, it's a video of the Saks Fifth Avenue Light Shows. I filmed it from three different angles to let you choose the angle you prefer to watch the show! title: Cloudy NYC walk tour with best view of Manhattan skyline - Nature & city sounds - 4K Quality
description:
Take a walk with me on this peaceful cloudy day beside the East River at Hunter’s Point South Park with the magnificent Manhattan skyline view. Be in the moment with me, and listen to nature and city sounds! Watch the New York City skyline from Hunter’s Point South in Long Island City. This area is my favorite place to walk and simultaneously see the river, skyline, and nature! So grateful to share this promenade with you all!

Please let me know what you like or dislike about my walk recordings in the comment section below! My channel is new, and your feedback is highly valuable to me! ❤️

I hope you enjoy this walk and have a fantastic night walking in NYC with me in this magical season !✨🎄

title: 4K NYC Walking - SoHo Manhattan New York - SoHo NYC 4K
description:
Hi guys! Take a walk with me in the SoHo area in lower Manhattan. SoHo is short for “South of Houston Street.” It is popular for many reasons, such as designer boutiques, fancy chain stores, art galleries, trendy bars, restaurants and nightlife hotspots. Also known for its elegant cast-iron facades and cobblestone streets and fashionable crowds.

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

I'm forever grateful that you're here! ❤️ If you like this video, please give it a thumbs up and subscribe to my channel for more videos.

title: ✨🗽 4K NYC Christmas Walk - World Trade Center - Brookfield Place -Oculus Wall Street -9/11 Memorial
description:
Hello guys!
During today's walk, we'll explore some of the most famous landmarks in the Financial District of New York City!
Starting from Fulton Street, we'll walk through the Financial District and check out the famous skyscrapers such ad World Trade Center (WTC) and Oculus Center. Next, we'll see the 9/11 memorial and Brookfield Place, the luxurious shopping district in Manhattan with some beautiful Christmas lights and decorations.

Finally, we'll walk through Wall Street and Stock Exchange Building by passing through Liberty and Zuccotti parks. At the end of our walk, we will see the famous Charging Bull, also sometimes referred to as the Bull of Wall Street! I hope you enjoy the walk and have a wonderful day/night! ☀️🌙 ✨
❤️ Love: Ellie

05:21 Giant Candy Canes
16:37 W 42nd St & 6th Ave
20:49 Ole & Steen: All-Day Danish Bakery in NYC
31:12 Herald Square

Hey Friends! 💕 Let's take a walk down 6th Avenue in New York City. Picture this: big, awesome holiday decorations all around, making the city feel super magical. And guess what? We're also going to check out the inside of Radio City Music Hall, where the Rockettes put on their amazing shows. It's going to be a blast! Come with me and enjoy the cool vibes of the city! 💕

🎥 Filmed on: 2:50 PM Thursday, December 21, 2023
Temperature: 37°F| 3°C 🌤️

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ellie.walkss

title: 4K NYC - Walking Billionaire Row - Columbus Circle - Madison Ave + Fifth Ave - LV Yayoi Kusama Robot
description:
Hey Friends!
In today's walk, we will visit 550 Madison Avenue's Public Plaza. Also, enter the 58-story Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue. Trump Tower - A 58-story skyscraper on Fifth Avenue, which was Donald Trump, his wife Melania, and their son's primary residence until October 2019. They lived in a three-story residence on the penthouse floors.
We will also see the interesting Louis Vuitton and Yayoi Kusama collaboration and watch Yayoi Kusama's robot painting the windows of Louis Vuitton. The robot is so human-like!
We continue by walking the Billionaires Row along 57th Street, a set of ultra-luxury residential skyscrapers arrayed along the southern end of Central Park in Manhattan. We will also visit the shops at the Columbus Circle and end our walk by the Columbus Circle. I hope you enjoy our walk!
Love /Ellie

title: 4K NYC-Spring Walk On Bustling Streets Of New York City!🗽🌸5th Ave, NBC Studios, Rockefeller Center
description:
Hey Friends! Today, let's take a spring walk through the bustling streets of New York City. We'll start on 6th Avenue and make our way down to 5th Avenue, passing by iconic landmarks like the Rockefeller Center, NBC Studios, where the "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon films. And St. Patrick's Cathedral. Let's enjoy the sights and sounds of this vibrant city together! //Ellie 🌸🌼🌸

Temperature: 55°F| 13°C

title: 4K NYC Walking - The High Line in New York City - Elevated High Line Park
description:
Hello friends! Today we are going to walk the exciting elevated High Line in New York City. We start from Hudson Yards and move towards The High Line. This park is a greenway and rail trail that is not in use anymore! On the way, we will see one of the beautiful Zaha Hadid buildings (one of my favorite architects), also The Little Island at pier 55 from a distance! I love the vibe of this area! Very lively! I hope you like it too!

Video Chapters:
00:00 Preview & Walk Map
10:24 Zaha Hadid Building in NYC
31:30 Little Island at Pier 55

If you like this video, please give it a thumbs up and subscribe to my channel for more videos like this. I'm so grateful that you're here XOXO

Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ellie.walkss

About Me 👩

title: ✨🎄 NYC Christmas Walk - Holiday Vibes At Bryant Park December 2022! Holiday Market & Winter Village!
description:
Hey friends!

In this virtual walk of Bryant Park, you'll get to experience the festive atmosphere around Christmas time in New York City! ✨🎄 You'll see the holiday market and winter village, as well as all of the festive lights in the park!

This is the perfect way to get into the Christmas spirit! In this video, you'll get to see all of the festive details of Bryant Park, from the beautiful Holiday Market to the dazzling Winter Village! If you're in NYC this holiday season, be sure to check out this video!

We'll take an evening walk, watch the delicious foods they are selling and the dazzling Christmas tree while we listen to some festive music! And we will watch some relaxing ice skating at the end of our walk! 🎵 💙 ⛸️ ❄️

I hope you enjoy our festive walk! Love from Ellie ❤️
I'm forever grateful that you're here! ❤️ If you like this video, please give it a thumbs up and subscribe to my channel for more videos.

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

title: 4K NYC Walk Spring 2023 | Queens to Manhattan with a Ferry Ride & Harry Potter Store Visit 🏙️⛴️🗽🍪🌸
description:
Hi Friends! 🌸 💕
Let's enjoy this New York City walk with Spring essence! We will start the walk from Long Island City in Queens and enjoy the Manhattan skyline, then take a ferry to Manhattan together. We continue our stroll from East 35 Street to Union Square in lower Manhattan. We will have short stops at the Harry Potter New York Store and another of my favorite bakeries, Breads Bakery. I hope you enjoy our walk! Let me know what part of this walk you like the most. /Ellie

Temperature: 54°F| 12°C

Shanghai Middle Ring Road, 70 kilometers long, also known as Shanghai Middle Ring Road, is a closed ring expressway in Shanghai. It is an urban expressway located between the Inner Ring Elevated Road and the S20 Outer Ring Expressway. It is one of the four ring expressways in Shanghai (Inner Ring Road, Middle Ring Road, S20 Outer Ring Expressway, G1503 Shanghai Ring Expressway)

Hey there, friends! 💕
Today's adventure takes us on a stroll through my neighborhood, where the cherry blossoms are in full bloom! But first, I'll make a yogurt parfait with granola for breakfast, because if it looks good, it tastes even better, right? We admired the stunning Manhattan skyline as we made our way to Hunter's Point South Park, where the cherry blossoms awaited us. After enjoying the blossoms, we stopped by a local coffee shop for a cup of joe before heading to Union Square's bustling spring market to relish in life's simple joys. Cheers to more adventures ahead! 🌸🌟

About Me 👩
I'm Ellie, a tech girl living in New York City who loves to walk, discover new places and film!

title: Live New York City! 🌧️🌧️ Rainy Night Walk Manhattan Midtown
description:
Hi Friends!
Let's enjoy this rainy night walking live together. I'm planning to start walking from 5th Ave and walk towards Broadway and Times Square and end the walk on 5th Avenue, close to Rockefeller Center and Radio City Music hall. I'll walk into a store along the way as well! I chose M&M'S World New York for this walk!
Also, let me know if you have any favorite stores you would like me to walk into. I already have a store in mind for today's walk, but I can plan it for our future walks!
Love /Ellie

title: NYC Walking - Village Halloween Parade 2022 -49th Annual Village Halloween Parade 2022
description:
Hey guys! Come and take a walk with me to watch the Village Halloween Parade 2022! The Parade ran straight up 6th Ave from KING St to West 15th. The 2022 Parade Theme was FREEDOM!

I filmed after a long day at work, but I totally enjoyed it! Even though I was pretty tired. I hope you enjoy it too!

In this Venice tour video, you'll feel as though you're right there, Venice walking through the city's vibrant streets and canals with a special unique atmosphere. title: Dyker Heights Christmas Lights 2023 4K Walking Tour ✨🗽 4K NYC Christmas Walk
description:
Hey Friends!
Let's enjoy the festive Christmas Lights and outdoor Christmas decorations in Dyker Heights wonderland! Dyker Heights, a neighborhood in Brooklyn, New York, transforms into a dazzling winter wonderland during the Christmas season. Each year, residents adorn their homes with elaborate and enchanting light displays, turning the streets into a magical spectacle of holiday cheer. From towering inflatable Santas to meticulously decorated lawns, Dyker Heights Christmas lights attract visitors from near and far, creating a festive tradition that brightens the hearts of all who witness this sparkling community celebration. Lucy Spata started the Christmas Lights tradition when she moved to the neighborhood in the 1980s. On our way, we will also see Lucy Spata House! ✨

北横通道是上海市中心城“三横三纵”骨架性主干路网的组成部分,西起中环路与北翟高架路相交的北虹路立交,
东至周家嘴路内江路,全长19.1km,经过长宁区、静安区、普陀区、虹口区和杨浦区。北横通道分为东西两部分,西段(中环北虹路立交至天目路立交文安路接地点)
于2021年6月18日开通,共计10.9公里。东段工程预计2023年底前竣工通车

The North Horizontal Corridor is a part of the "three horizontal and three vertical" skeleton trunk road network in the central city of Shanghai.
It ends at Zhoujiazui Road and Neijiang Road in the east, with a total length of 19.1km, passing through Changning District, Jing'an District, Putuo District, Hongkou District and Yangpu District. The north cross passage is divided into two parts, the east and the west, and the west section (the grounding point of Wen'an Road from the Beihong Road Interchange in the Central Ring to the Tianmu Road Interchange)
It will be opened on June 18, 2021, with a total length of 10.9 kilometers. The eastern section of the project is expected to be completed and open to traffic by the end of 2023

description:
Hey Friends!
Last weekend, I was in East Village, a popular and dynamic neighborhood in New York City, and I filmed it for you. East Village is known for its restaurants, bars, nightlife, music venues and beautiful community gardens.
We start from 4th Ave & E 8th St and walk towards Avenue A and Tompkins Square Park. Along the way, we will have a short stop at Ray's Candy Store and Tompkins Square Bagels. I will also try the popular Fried Oreos from Ray's Candy Store. We will also pass the famous Prince Tea House. I hope you enjoy the walk!
XOXO Ellie

title: 4K Rain Walk New York City | Times Square Rainy Night Dec 2023
description:
Hey Friends! Take a nighttime walk with me on a rainy night at Times Square in Midtown Manhattan, New York City in Winter 2023! Time Square is the busiest, most magnificent and most popular place to visit in NYC, with all the lights and electronic billboards. Times Square is also famous for the best broadway shows. It is a hub for the Broadway Theater District and a major center of the world's entertainment industry. It stretches from West 42nd to West 47th Streets and some calls it the "Center Of Universe."

Also, if you like this video, please like and subscribe to help me grow my channel!

Today, let's explore the Upper East Side of Manhattan via 5th Avenue along Central Park. We will also pass along The MET or The Metropolitan Museum of Art. Also, have a short stop at one of the most popular cafes/bakeries in New York City, Levain Bakery. They have multiple stores in different parts of the city. Today let's explore their store at Upper East Side. I hope you enjoy this walk and have a wonderful day! /Ellie

title: 4K NYC Walking - Brooklyn Bridge Day And Night View - Plus Amazing Sunset View
description:
#nycwalkingtour #nycwalking #brooklynbridge #manhattan #brooklyn #nyc #newyork

Hey friends!
Today, we'll be taking a walk across the Brooklyn Bridge in New York City! We start our walk during the day, just before the sunset and end it at night, which turns into a fantastic view of the city. With this timing, you can see both of Brooklyn Bridge night view and Brooklyn Bridge day view! Brooklyn Bridge has located just a short distance from Manhattan and offers a beautiful view of the Manhattan skyline. You can enjoy the sights, including Manhattan Skyscrapers from midtown to downtown, the Empire State Building, the Chrysler building, the One World Trade Center (formerly known as the freedom tower), and the blue Manhattan Bridge.

We will see different angles and viewpoints day and night on this walk! I filmed it intentionally so that you can see both day and night views and in case you plan to visit the bridge in person, you choose for yourself when is the best time to visit!

The iconic Brooklyn Bridge goes from Manhattan to Dumbo in Brooklyn. It stretches across the East River. The bridge opened in 1883 to carry nonautomotive traffic (at the time) between Manhattan and Brooklyn. Today it takes both nonautomotive and automotive traffic.

If you like this video, please give it a thumbs up and subscribe to my channel for more videos ❤️

#timessquare #nycwalkingtour #newyork4k #bigapple #newyorkwalker
Hi Friends! 👋
Let's walk together from Bryant Park on Fifth Ave to Times Square and experience the NYC Hustle and Bustle on the way. We also will have a few stops on our way and check out some iconic stores in Times Square. We will see the Hard Rock Cafe in Times Square, Line Friends New York Times Square Store, Hershey's Chocolate World and Disney Store. I hope you enjoy this walk as much as I did! 😊 💕
